name: Autodrom Sosnová - 14.11.2026 layout
description: Autodrom Sosnová (Česká Lípa, Czech Republic), special combined layout used for the 14.11.2026 event: main circuit, top chicane section, Sosnová Classic hairpin, Driving Camp handling loops and the start straight. Geometry from the Czech state orthophoto (ČÚZK, 12.5 cm/px) and LiDAR terrain (DMR 5G): real road edges, real elevation, paddock, gravel, buildings, trees and cone chicanes at their true positions. Not affiliated with the circuit owner.
author: Starter kit (ČÚZK Ortofoto + DMR 5G, CC BY 4.0)
